verdict.rationale: A state business-filing agency could plausibly offer programmatic event callbacks, such as filing-status updates, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only email filing acknowledgements and an announcements signup, neither of which is a registrable outbound HTTP callback. Probes found no API surface at all (OpenAPI paths 404, and the filing host reset the connection).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
